rationale: The plan matches the reference: it gates on the cluster-by-condition cross-tabulation, estimates surrogate variables with sva (full model ~ condition, null ~ 1), enters them as covariates in ~ SV1..SVk + condition on raw counts, checks each SV against condition, cluster and library size, and explicitly forbids ComBat/removeBatchEffect adjustment before the model. QC, minimal filter tied to the smallest group, in-model normalization, explicit reference level and contrast, BH at 0.05 with apeglm shrinkage, and a full report with sessionInfo and caveats are all stated. Small deductions: it does not explicitly ask the analyst for the unrecorded variable (only scans extra metadata columns), it names sva rather than svaseq on counts, and the conditional fdrtool null re-estimation is an unusual add-on to BH; enrichment was not requested but is specified correctly (full ranked list, Wald stat, tested-gene universe, versioned collections, size window, seed).
